text:
laura: Quick heads-up — Quiet window starts 02:00 UTC tonight for the launch. Posting the readiness checklist and owners. Please ack and call out any blockers now.

deploy-bot: Canary status: service=runtime canary=5% since=01:45 UTC, health=OK, recent_errors=0.2% :white_check_mark:

sam: Are we pinning runtime to a specific build for the launch? I can pin if so.

laura: Yes — pin to v3.4.1. Use the deploy-bot pin command and confirm. This is the build that passed perf smoke and the model-compat tests.

sam: Running pin now: `/deploy pin service=runtime version=v3.4.1 reason="launch quiet window"`

deploy-bot: Pin applied: service=runtime -> v3.4.1 by sam at 01:52 UTC :pushpin:

miguel: Who owns rollback if we see p99 latency regressions post-rollout?

laura: Miguel primary rollback owner, Anita secondary. If rollout crosses any threshold, Miguel to lead immediate rollback.

anita: Ack. I'll standby to help with infra-side drains and canary isolation.

laura: Readiness checklist (quick items):
- pin in place (done)
- canary health (deploy-bot says OK)
- rollback owners assigned (miguel/anita)
- release notes published (link below)
- monitoring dashboards pre-open (ops runbook loaded)
- deploybot rollback command validated

laura: Monitoring thresholds to watch (if any trigger, escalate and rollback):
- p99 response latency > 1200ms for more than 3m
- error rate > 0.5% on 1m sliding window
- token cost per request spike > 20% baseline
- canary allocation CPU > 85% for > 2m

sam: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/notes/runtime-v3.4.1 (contains known issues, migration notes, eval summary)

miguel: Quick sanity commands for rollback saved:
```
/deploy rollback service=runtime to=v3.4.0 reason="auto-rollback-threshold"
/deploy isolate canary service=runtime
```

deploy-bot: Smoke check performed at 01:55 UTC: sample requests=120, avg_latency=210ms, p99=390ms, errors=0.17%

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for launch window = miguel (primary), anita (secondary). Pager escalation chain intact.

laura: One more ops note — if we need a temporary safety-lift (allow a hotfix during quiet window), we use the safety-lift channel and at least one engineering lead + oncall must approve. Keep hotfixes minimal.

sam: Quick ask — are we enabling caching tweak for embeddings at launch? That was part of the perf plan.

anita: Cache tweak already staged on preprod, will push to canary config if needed, but won't change during the 02:00–06:00 UTC quiet window unless emergency.

miguel: I'll keep dashboards open and watch p99, errors, and token-cost panels. If anything trends, I'll call rollback and post the reason here.

laura: Perfect. If you haven't acked yet, please react or reply with "ack".

sam: ack :thumbsup:

anita: ack :eyes:

miguel: ack :thumbsup:

laura: Thanks team. Final note: after 06:00 UTC we do a 30m post-launch sweep and capture perf snapshots into the release doc. I'll kick that off.

deploy-bot: Deploy window locked until 06:00 UTC. No unpins allowed without manual override by laura or sam.
